answer: Orchard yield-table bond: each identity tends an orchard plot, locking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it files a ridge harvest; the public table lists ridge yields and a nadir floor no tended plot falls below. Auditors recompute each filing; an out-of-band reading or reused serial burns the bond, so rented-orchard rings fail. First filing 38, k-th 38+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500 + 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. An honest grower pays 38 once.
